Competitions

One yearly competition.

Smaller mentor-led events sit beside it.

The 2027 footprint is Texas (Dallas–Fort Worth), Cameroon (a Yaoundé event that AfroBot is hosting), and Tanzania. The first season is an 8-team pilot. Teams are about 8 students plus coaches.

Get updates

2027 hubs

Separate dates

Texas (DFW), Cameroon (Yaoundé), and Tanzania meet on separate dates and share a two-way livestream.

AfroBot teams build AI and robotics solutions, then present that work at a regional showcase and a national showcase. The season is complementary to other youth robotics programs.

Tanzania

Its own dates

Tanzania is a planned hub on its own dates.
